statusMeaning.active: Work is continuing on the resolver, evidence model, distribution and adoption surfaces.
statusMeaning.pre-stable: The project is usable for experimentation, but the profile contract and toolchain have not reached a stable 1.0 release.

events.title: Project started
events.summary: ARWP was created as a small, inspectable discovery profile for websites exposing web, data, retrieval and agent-facing interfaces.

events.title: v0.1.0 experimental baseline released
events.summary: The first tagged release shipped the profile contract, JSON Schema, validator, verifier, GitHub Action and local/remote MCP gateway foundations.

events.title: Resolver-first architecture adopted
events.summary: The project moved from manifest-first positioning to an evidence-backed resolver that normalizes existing web and agent discovery surfaces instead of replacing them.

events.title: Evidence discipline became part of the product
events.summary: Benchmark truth, live publisher drift and negative experiments were separated so the project could keep failed or no-gain results instead of expanding the format by assumption.

events.title: Consumer onboarding path hardened
events.summary: A tested local onboarding path and package-boundary fixes made the project easier to evaluate from a clean consumer environment.

events.title: Product history and multilingual agent discovery
events.summary: ARWP now publishes an explicit product history plus canonical English and localized German/Russian llms.txt routing surfaces with a machine-readable locale manifest. English remains the normative technical language.
